headline: Today's run couldn't open any web pages, so the API changelogs went unchecked and there's no new outside research; the two ideas come from reading the bot's own code: make the tilt guard tell you when it stops working, and make the scanner show when Binance data is missing.

ideas.title: Tell me when the tilt guard goes quiet
ideas.why: If the guard's Binance calls start failing (PC clock drift, key or API change), it only writes a log line, so you trade thinking it's watching. Alert in Telegram after ~2 minutes of errors and again when it's back, and sync the clock with Binance's server time.

ideas.title: Data health line on every scan
ideas.why: When an OI, taker or long/short call fails, the scanner quietly drops that part of the score, or the whole coin. Show 'OI missing for 12 of 30 coins' on /scan, the Mini App and the 08:00 brief, so a Binance change or rate limit shows up on day one.
